import CategoryTheory.Limits
import Fintype
import CategoryTheory.Functor.Inclusion

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {G : Type v} [Group G] [Finite G] :
  CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesColimitsOfShape (CategoryTheory.SingleObj G) FintypeCat.incl := by
  let J : Type u := SingleObj G
  let F : J ⥤ FintypeCat := fun _ => empty
  let F' : J ⥤ Type v := fun _ => PUnit
  let F'' : J ⥤ Set := fun _ => PUnit
  let F''' : J ⥤ Group G := fun _ => trivial_group

  -- Step 1: Show that FintypeCat.incl is fully faithful
  have hf : FintypeCat.incl.is_full := FintypeCat.incl.is_full
  have hi : FintypeCat.incl.is_faithful := FintypeCat.incl.is_faithful

  -- Step 2: Use the fact that colimits in FintypeCat are computed as colimits in Set
  have hcolim : ∀ {J : Type u} (F : J ⥤ FintypeCat), IsColimit (FintypeCat.incl ⋙ colimit F) :=
  { intros J F,
    let F_set : J ⥤ Set := F ⋙ Fintype.toSet
    let colim_set : Set := colimit F_set
    let colim_fintype : FintypeCat := colimit F
    let colim_incl : colim_fintype ⟶ FintypeCat.incl.colim_obj :=
      FintypeCat.incl.map_colimit_map (colimit_map F_set)
    let colim_incl_is_colimit : IsColimit (FintypeCat.incl ⋙ colimit F) :=
      { colim_obj := colim_fintype,
        colim_map := colim_incl,
        universal := begin
          intro X,
          intro f,
          use colim_incl,
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          exact f
        end,
        universal_unique := begin
          intro X,
          intro f,
          intro g,
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          exact eq_of_maps_eq (f ≫ colim_incl) (g ≫ colim_incl)
        end }
    exact colim_incl_is_colimit }

  -- Step 3: Apply the lemma that if a functor reflects colimits and is fully faithful, it preserves colimits
  have hpres : PreservesColimitsOfShape J FintypeCat.incl :=
  { intros F,
    let F_set : J ⥤ Set := F ⋙ Fintype.toSet
    let colim_set : Set := colimit F_set
    let colim_fintype : FintypeCat := colimit F
    let colim_incl : colim_fintype ⟶ FintypeCat.incl.colim_obj :=
      FintypeCat.incl.map_colimit_map (colimit_map F_set)
    let colim_incl_is_colimit : IsColimit (FintypeCat.incl ⋙ colimit F) :=
      { colim_obj := colim_fintype,
        colim_map := colim_incl,
        universal := begin
          intro X,
          intro f,
          use colim_incl,
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          exact f
        end,
        universal_unique := begin
          intro X,
          intro f,
          intro g,
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          erw [colimit_map_unique],
          exact eq_of_maps_eq (f ≫ colim_incl) (g ≫ colim_incl)
        end }
    exact colim_incl_is_colimit }

  -- Final step: Conclude using the above
  exact hpres
